import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_75/test_0.csv"

# Load source data, ignoring the first index column
df = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Columns to encode as categorical codes (string to int)
string_cols_to_encode = ['neighbourhood', 'name', 'host_name', 'neighbourhood_group', 'room_type']

# Convert 'last_review' to datetime, then to integer days since epoch
df['last_review'] = pd.to_datetime(df['last_review'], errors='coerce')
epoch = pd.Timestamp("1970-01-01")
df['last_review'] = (df['last_review'] - epoch).dt.days
df['last_review'] = df['last_review'].fillna(-1).astype(int)

# Encode string columns as categorical codes
for col in string_cols_to_encode:
    df[col] = df[col].astype('category').cat.codes

# Convert float columns to int by rounding
df['reviews_per_month'] = df['reviews_per_month'].round().fillna(0).astype(int)

# Convert latitude and longitude to int by rounding
df['latitude'] = df['latitude'].round().astype(int)
df['longitude'] = df['longitude'].round().astype(int)

# Convert other numeric columns to int (some may be float due to NaNs)
int_cols = ['id', 'host_id', 'price', 'minimum_nights', 'number_of_reviews',
            'calculated_host_listings_count', 'availability_365']
for col in int_cols:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Group by 'neighbourhood' (leftmost unique string column)
# Aggregate:
# - For categorical columns: take max (assuming consistent per neighbourhood)
# - For numeric columns: take mean (average)
agg_dict = {
    'id': 'max',
    'name': 'max',
    'host_id': 'max',
    'host_name': 'max',
    'neighbourhood_group': 'max',
    'latitude': 'mean',
    'longitude': 'mean',
    'room_type': 'max',
    'price': 'mean',
    'minimum_nights': 'mean',
    'number_of_reviews': 'mean',
    'last_review': 'mean',
    'reviews_per_month': 'mean',
    'calculated_host_listings_count': 'mean',
    'availability_365': 'mean'
}

df_grouped = df.groupby('neighbourhood', as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# After aggregation, convert all columns except 'neighbourhood' to int (rounding means)
for col in df_grouped.columns:
    if col != 'neighbourhood':
        df_grouped[col] = df_grouped[col].round().astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
target_columns = ['neighbourhood', 'id', 'name', 'host_id', 'host_name', 'neighbourhood_group',
                  'latitude', 'longitude', 'room_type', 'price', 'minimum_nights', 'number_of_reviews',
                  'last_review', 'reviews_per_month', 'calculated_host_listings_count', 'availability_365']

df_target = df_grouped[target_columns]

# Save to output CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_75/target_multisource_critique_history.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
